column1: # The kernel icon table: one row per `Icon`. `tools/icons/gen.mjs` compiles it (with the SVGs under
# assets/svg and the boxes in segoe-boxes.tsv) into src/generated.rs and data/paths.bin.
# key     the character that stands for the icon in text (hex). An icon that replaced a Segoe
#         Fluent Icons / Segoe MDL2 Assets glyph keeps that glyph's code point; the rest count up
# fluent  the Fluent UI System Icons asset name; its 16/20/24 masters that exist are compiled.
#         `nova:<Name>` is one of the kernel's own outlines (assets/svg/ic_nova_*.svg), drawn for a
#         mark Fluent has no match for.
# box     where the ink goes in the em box: `segoe` = the Segoe glyph of this key, `segoe:XXXX` =
#         the Segoe glyph of another key (a variant of that icon), `native` = the outline's own ink
# used by who draws it, for the docs.
